g.text: QuincyAmirSoldier begins.
hey
talked to the lil speedster like u said
How'd it go?
Wow. You actually listened to me?
In the middle of something, sorry. [End.]
first he thought i was gonna punch him in the face lmao. but i took him up onto the roof n we sat down n we talked
fking shove it n let me talk, will u?
Chat ends.
i told him about when i joined the army n how i became a sniper
How *did* you become a sniper, anyway?
And?
not important rn
told him bout the first time i had to kill somebody
about the first time i had 2 look down that sight n take a life
its 1 thing when ur in the heat of battle...some goon is coming at u with a gun or a knife or w/e...
another thing entirely when ur on a roof 300 yrds away n they dont even know ur there...
n u got time to *think* about them. who they r. why they r there. do they got a family? kids?
n... then u squeeze the trigger. BOOM
doesnt matter now
they dead, n i took that life
n that face lives in my head
n so does every single 1 thats come after
How'd he react...?
Sounds... uplifting.
didnt say anything 4 the longest time. we just sat there in silence
then he...told me about the nightmares hes been getting
n how he feels like hes not really part of the group bc hes not a soldier
so i told him about how horrifying it was 4 me when i first had 2 kill as a soldier
n how i used 2 get nightmares over it, worse than the ones even when i was a lil kid
but i told him sorry that id been treating him like such a plumsack this whole time
n that he belonged with us just as much as anybody does. n that i just got a way 'bout me, just like he's got a way 'bout him, n its just who we r, u know?
.... n then u know what he said...?
What?
No?
"ur right, ur a dickhead"
but just as i was about 2 push him off the roof?
he hugged me. fking hugged me. n said 'but ur also my big brother'
wtf
but... nah. worth. think it meant something 2 him, really... n... meant somethin' 2 me, 2. i guess
+20 Chemistry
so... thnx
Chat ends.
